command:
set -e
source /opt/miniconda3/bin/activate testbed
export PYTHONPATH=/testbed
cd /testbed
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 43ec09c3cbb089edd2e83ccc717fb95beef0c189
git apply --check /evidence/candidate.patch
git apply /evidence/candidate.patch
if git cat-file -e 43ec09c3cbb089edd2e83ccc717fb95beef0c189:tests/test_content_streams.py 2>/dev/null; then git checkout 43ec09c3cbb089edd2e83ccc717fb95beef0c189 -- tests/test_content_streams.py; else rm -f -- tests/test_content_streams.py; fi
git apply /evidence/test.patch
python -c 'import httpx; assert httpx.__file__.startswith("/testbed/"); print("IMPORT_FROM_TASK_VERIFIED")'
pytest --no-header -rA --tb=line --color=no -p no:cacheprovider -W ignore::DeprecationWarning tests/test_content_streams.py --maxfail=0 --junitxml=/evidence/candidate.xml
